data.headline: Stock 3 weeks and boost marketing 25% to lift weekly profit
data.why: The plan adds three weeks of safety stock and a 25% marketing push. The figures above show a positive weekly profit bridge driven by higher volume that more than covers the extra marketing and holding costs, with payback by week 4 and peak cash well within the 8,000 available.
data.watch_out: If the marketing spend does not translate into the expected volume lift, cash burn accelerates and the buffer shrinks; monitor weekly sales and marketing ROI closely.
data.recheck_when: Review at week 4 payback point or if a bean-cost shock hits the Central Highlands region.
